fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO) received an upward rating from D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria with a price target of $400 (approximately 17% upside), though the stock is down roughly 30% from its early-year high.
fields.summary_ko.1: AVGO's Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7B increased 221% YoY, and with the stock trading at 16x forward P/E, there is substantial upside upon deal realization.
